skills.name: mcu-debug
skills.description: Flash, verify and debug ARM Cortex-M firmware through DAPLink/CMSIS-DAP probes. Provides 47 subcommands for probe/target discovery, CMSIS-Packs, flashing, hardware and flash breakpoints, conditional breakpoints with on-hit scripts, DWARF CFI backtraces, C expression evaluation, SVD peripherals, RTOS threads, RTT, SWO/ITM, semihosting, multicore, DWT cycle counting, and a rule-based HardFault analyser with self-contained HTML reports. Supports both pyOCD and probe-rs backends with automatic chip-name routing. On WSL it auto-detects Windows-side probes through usbipd and can attach them to the distro. Use when the user asks to flash or erase a board, attach a debugger, inspect registers/memory, set breakpoints, capture RTT/SWO output, or diagnose a crash/HardFault. Also builds SCMCU/PIC firmware with the bundled XC8 flow and drives the CACHIP USB HID programmer for CA51 touch MCUs (burning, touch calibration, firmware slots, downloader updates).
skills.short_description: Debug/flash Cortex-M, build XC8 firmware, burn/calibrate CACHIP touch MCUs

interface.short_description: Debug/flash Cortex-M, build XC8 firmware, burn/calibrate CACHIP touch MCUs
interface.default_prompt: Use $mcu-debug to flash or debug a Cortex-M target, build SCMCU/PIC firmware with XC8, or burn/calibrate a CACHIP CA51 touch MCU.
